items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: So we rehearsed for about three or four weeks and had this act. He had been an entertainer around New York, you know. ... And we had an act formed -- Clarence Potter and his Jazz Babies.

ctx.x: A singer, singer, yeah. He sang songs just like Harry Lauder sings, in Scotch, and he was real dark but he had real sharp features. Looked as though -- like some other race, blacked up -- that's the way he looked. Very handsome guy, short and stocky. So we rehearsed for about three or four weeks and had this act. He had been an entertainer around New York, you know. In those days entertaining, singing musicians were the thing. You know, if you couldn't sing, you didn't make the money.
